safety_tips.tip: Watch belongings in crowded areas like markets, bus stations and tourist hotspots
Avoid displaying large amounts of cash or expensive jewellery
Keep passport, money and cards in a hotel safe or concealed money belt
Keep photocopies and digital copies of passport, visa, tickets and insurance separate from originals
Avoid walking alone at night in unlit or isolated areas
At night, use a registered taxi or transport arranged through the hotel
Never leave drinks unattended or accept drinks from strangers

health_tips.tip: Use high SPF broad-spectrum sunscreen, sunglasses, a wide-brimmed hat and SPF lip balm
Use insect repellent, as mosquitoes are present especially in evenings and humid areas
Carry a basic first-aid kit with band-aids, antiseptic wipes, pain relievers and motion sickness medication
Carry personal medications in original packaging with a copy of the prescription
Unicare Pharmacie sells general medications, open 8am–8pm daily and closes at 1pm on Sunday
health_tips._source_file: Mauritius/Copy of Mauritius All Inclusive Guide - Pradeep(1).docx

season_notes.tip: May is usually dry with an occasional shower
Evenings can be cooler, especially on the central plateau or near the coast where breezes pick up
June evenings can be breezy near the coast; carry a light jacket or pashmina
June days are humid; pack lightweight, breathable fabrics
